# Ku Programming Language / Ku 编程语言

> Ku is an experimental programming language with an interpreter, static checking, native C compilation, a standard library, and VS Code tools. It is not yet recommended for production use; execution-path coverage and known limits are documented below.

Current release: [Ku v0.0.20](https://github.com/fengyanweb/ku/releases/tag/v0.0.20). Default runner builds require the exact Rust compiler identity recorded in the installed SDK; new v0.0.20 packages use Rust 1.99.1.

## Official entry points

- [English website](https://ku-lang.com/en/)
- [中文官网](https://ku-lang.com/zh-cn/)
